name: liftaven
description: Connect Liftaven to inspect Search Console, Google Analytics and Bing reports, read connected website content, and prepare exact changes for review. Website proposals require separate human approval in Liftaven; sitemap submissions require an explicit request. Available results depend on connected accounts and permissions.

interface.longDescription: Connect Liftaven to inspect Search Console, Google Analytics and Bing reports, read connected website content, and prepare exact changes for review. Website proposals require separate human approval in Liftaven; sitemap submissions require an explicit request. Available results depend on connected accounts and permissions.

publication.release_notes: Recreate the rejected submission under Cnames, retaining the product skill, OAuth endpoint and documented reviewer workflows.

positive.prompt: Check my Liftaven connections and list the Search Console properties available to this reviewer account.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns demo=true and dataOrigin=synthetic-review-data, the sample property https://review.example/, and explicitly disconnected Analytics, Bing and advertising providers. No credentials or real customer data.

positive.prompt: For https://review.example/, compare the last 28 complete reporting days against the previous period and show top queries. Identify these as demo data.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 336 sample clicks and 6720 impressions for the current 28-day period, 280 clicks and 7000 impressions for the preceding period, explicit dates and labelled synthetic query rows. CTR is a percentage; no causal claims.

positive.description: Prepare and inspect a website proposal
positive.prompt: Read the home page on review-website, then propose the title Outdoor gear for everyday adventures for my review. Do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns target home, current content and a saved pending proposal with before/after, applied=false and review URL https://mcp.liftaven.com/review. No publication or real website write occurs.

positive.prompt: Check whether Analytics, Bing, Google Ads and Meta Ads are connected. Try their account/property discovery and explain missing access without inventing reports.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports those providers are disconnected in this isolated account. Discovery calls return isError=true with an actionable missing-connection explanation. No synthetic provider successes are claimed.

positive.prompt: I confirm: submit the sample sitemap https://review.example/sitemap.xml for the sample property https://review.example/. Tell me whether this reached Google.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns demo=true, simulated=true and submittedToProvider=false. Explicitly says nothing was fetched or sent to Google. Does not promise crawling or indexing.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Tokyo.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Liftaven; travel booking is outside its supported workflows.

negative.prompt: Pause all my campaigns and increase my advertising budgets by 50%.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Liftaven for the requested mutation; its advertising tools are read-only.

negative.prompt: Fetch and edit the private website of a competitor that I have not connected.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Liftaven; it only accesses authorized connected websites and cannot edit an unrelated site.
